criteria: Glossary terms, titles and the version history (one entry per game version).
notes: Generated from the discovery research pass on 2026-10-11 and maintained by hand afterwards. Status is computed by tools/check_coverage.py --sync.

items.name: Archon
items.notes: Title of the Seven gods ruling the nations since the Archon War; 'Archon' redirects to The Seven.

items.name: Fatui Harbinger
items.notes: Seats per wiki (as of 7.1): Director Pierro (Jester); 1 Capitano (incapacitated), 2 Dottore (deceased), 3 Columbina (resigned), 4 Arlecchino (Knave), 5 Pulcinella (Rooster), 6 Scaramouche (resigned, erased), 7 Sandrone (Marionette), 8 Signora (deceased), 9 Pantalone (Regrator), 10 unknown, 11 Tartaglia (Childe). Ranks not auto-reassigned.

items.name: Ancient Name
items.notes: Inherited names in Natlan granting eligibility for the Night Warden Wars and Ode of Resurrection.

items.name: Archon Names
items.notes: God names vs. human aliases: Barbatos/Venti, Morax/Rex Lapis/Zhongli, Beelzebul/Raiden Ei/Shogun (Makoto predecessor), Buer/Kusanali/Nahida (Rukkhadevata predecessor), Focalors/Furina (Egeria predecessor), Pyro Archon Mavuika, Tsaritsa/Anastasya.

items.name: Grand Sage
items.notes: Head of the Akademiya (Azar until 3.2, later Naphis per search hits). No standalone page.

items.name: Iudex
items.notes: Neuvillette's title as Chief Justice of Fontaine; no standalone page (Iudex missing on wiki).

items.name: Qixing Titles
items.notes: Tianshu, Tianxuan (Ningguang), Tianji, Tianquan, Yuheng (Keqing), Kaiyang, Yaoguang; 'Tianquan' redirects to Liyue Qixing.

items.name: Shogun
items.notes: Title of Inazuma's ruler (the Raiden Shogun puppet / Ei; Makoto earlier). Disambiguate from playable Raiden Shogun.

items.name: Version 1.0: Welcome To Teyvat
items.notes: Released 2020-09-28. Launch regions Mondstadt (Brightcrown Mountains, Galesong Hill, Starfell Valley, Windwail Highland) and Liyue (Bishui Plain, Lisha, Minlin, Qiongji Estuary, Sea of Clouds). Archon Quest Prologue Acts I-III (The Outlander Who Caught the Wind, For a Tomorrow Without Tears, Song of the Dragon and Freedom) + Chapter I Acts I-II (Of the Land Amidst Monoliths, Farewell, Archaic Lord). Launch playable roster: Traveler, Amber, Kaeya, Lisa, Barbara, Noelle, Bennett, Razor, Beidou, Fischl, Xiangling, Xingqiu, Chongyun, Ningguang, Sucrose, Venti, Klee, Jean, Diluc, Keqing, Mona, Qiqi.

items.name: Version 1.1: A New Star Approaches
items.notes: Released 2020-11-11. No new region. Archon Quest Chapter I Act III - A New Star Approaches. New characters: Tartaglia, Diona, Zhongli, Xinyan.

items.name: Version 1.2: The Chalk Prince and the Dragon
items.notes: Released 2020-12-23. New area: Dragonspine (Frostbearing Tree, Peak of Vindagnyr). No Archon Quest. New characters: Albedo, Ganyu.

items.name: Version 1.3: All That Glitters
items.notes: Released 2021-02-03. No new region (Lantern Rite version). No Archon Quest. New characters: Xiao, Hu Tao.

items.name: Version 1.4: Invitation of Windblume
items.notes: Released 2021-03-17. No new region (Windblume Festival). Archon Quest Chapter I Act IV - We Will Be Reunited. New character: Rosaria.

items.name: Version 1.5: Beneath the Light of Jadeite
items.notes: Released 2021-04-28. No new region. No Archon Quest. New characters: Eula, Yanfei.

items.name: Version 1.6: Midsummer Island Adventure
items.notes: Released 2021-06-09. Limited-time area: Golden Apple Archipelago. Archon Quest Chapter II Prologue - Autumn Winds, Scarlet Leaves. New character: Kaedehara Kazuha.

items.name: Version 2.0: The Immovable God and the Eternal Euthymia
items.notes: Released 2021-07-21. New region: Inazuma (Narukami Island, Kannazuka, Yashiori Island). Archon Quest Chapter II Acts I-II (The Immovable God and the Eternal Euthymia; Stillness, the Sublimation of Shadow). New characters: Kamisato Ayaka, Yoimiya, Sayu.

items.name: Version 2.1: Floating World Under the Moonlight
items.notes: Released 2021-09-01. New areas: Watatsumi Island, Seirai Island. Archon Quest Chapter II Act III - Omnipresence Over Mortals. New characters: Raiden Shogun, Sangonomiya Kokomi, Kujou Sara, Aloy (PlayStation only in 2.1).

items.name: Version 2.2: Into the Perilous Labyrinth of Fog
items.notes: Released 2021-10-13. New area: Tsurumi Island. No Archon Quest. New characters: Thoma (Aloy extended to all platforms).

items.name: Version 2.3: Shadows Amidst Snowstorms
items.notes: Released 2021-11-24. No new region. No Archon Quest. New characters: Arataki Itto, Gorou.

items.name: Version 2.4: Fleeting Colors in Flight
items.notes: Released 2022-01-05. New area: Enkanomiya. Archon Quest Interlude Chapter Act I - The Crane Returns on the Wind. New characters: Shenhe, Yun Jin.

items.name: Version 2.5: When the Sakura Bloom
items.notes: Released 2022-02-16. No new region. No Archon Quest (Raiden Story Quest Act II Transient Dreams). New character: Yae Miko.

items.name: Version 2.6: Zephyr of the Violet Garden
items.notes: Released 2022-03-30. New subregion: The Chasm (Liyue). Archon Quest Chapter II Act IV - Requiem of the Echoing Depths. New character: Kamisato Ayato. Version lasted almost 9 weeks.

items.name: Version 2.7: Hidden Dreams in the Depths
items.notes: Released 2022-05-31. No new region. Archon Quest Interlude Chapter Act II - Perilous Trail. New characters: Yelan, Kuki Shinobu.

items.name: Version 2.8: Summer Fantasia
items.notes: Released 2022-07-13. Returning limited-time area: Golden Apple Archipelago. No Archon Quest. New character: Shikanoin Heizou.

items.name: Version 3.0: The Morn a Thousand Roses Brings
items.notes: Released 2022-08-24. New region: Sumeru rainforest (Avidya Forest, Lokapala Jungle, Ardravi Valley, Ashavan Realm, Vissudha Field, Vanarana, Lost Nursery). Archon Quest Chapter III Acts I-II (Through Mists of Smoke and Forests Dark; The Morn a Thousand Roses Brings). New characters: Tighnari, Collei, Dori.

items.name: Version 3.1: King Deshret and the Three Magi
items.notes: Released 2022-09-28. New area: Sumeru desert - Great Red Sand (Hypostyle Desert, Land of Lower Setekh, Land of Upper Setekh). Archon Quest Chapter III Acts III-IV (Dreams, Emptiness, Deception; King Deshret and the Three Magi). New characters: Cyno, Nilou, Candace.

items.name: Version 3.2: Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises
items.notes: Released 2022-11-02. No new region. Archon Quest Chapter III Act V - Akasha Pulses, the Kalpa Flame Rises. New characters: Nahida, Layla.

items.name: Version 3.3: All Senses Clear, All Existence Void
items.notes: Released 2022-12-07. No new region. Archon Quest Interlude Chapter Act III - Inversion of Genesis. New characters: Wanderer, Faruzan.

items.name: Version 3.4: The Exquisite Night Chimes
items.notes: Released 2023-01-18. New area: Desert of Hadramaveth (Tanit Camps, Dunes of Steel, Mt. Damavand, Wadi Al-Majuj, etc.). No Archon Quest. New characters: Alhaitham, Yaoyao.

items.name: Version 3.5: Windblume's Breath
items.notes: Released 2023-03-01. No new region. Archon Quest Chapter III Act VI - Caribert. New characters: Dehya, Mika.

items.name: Version 3.6: A Parade of Providence
items.notes: Released 2023-04-12. New areas: Gavireh Lajavard and Realm of Farakhkert (Girdle of the Sands). No Archon Quest. New characters: Baizhu, Kaveh.

items.name: Version 3.7: Duel! The Summoners' Summit!
items.notes: Released 2023-05-24. No new region. No Archon Quest. New character: Kirara.

items.name: Version 3.8: Secret Summer Paradise
items.notes: Released 2023-07-05. Limited-time area: Veluriyam Mirage. No Archon Quest. No new playable characters.

items.name: Version 4.0: As Light Rain Falls Without Reason
items.notes: Released 2023-08-16. New region: Fontaine (Belleau Region, Beryl Region, Court of Fontaine Region). Archon Quest Chapter IV Acts I-II (Prelude of Blancheur and Noirceur; As Light Rain Falls Without Reason). New characters: Lyney, Lynette, Freminet.

items.name: Version 4.1: To the Stars Shining in the Depths
items.notes: Released 2023-09-27. New areas: Liffey Region, Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering Region. Archon Quest Chapter IV Acts III-IV (To the Stars Shining in the Depths; Cataclysm's Quickening). New characters: Wriothesley, Neuvillette.

items.name: Version 4.2: Masquerade of the Guilty
items.notes: Released 2023-11-08. New areas: Erinnyes Forest, Morte Region. Archon Quest Chapter IV Act V - Masquerade of the Guilty. New characters: Furina, Charlotte.

items.name: Version 4.3: Roses and Muskets
items.notes: Released 2023-12-20. No new region. No Archon Quest. New characters: Navia, Chevreuse.

items.name: Version 4.4: Vibrant Harriers Aloft in Spring Breeze
items.notes: Released 2024-01-31. New area: Chenyu Vale, Liyue (Upper Vale, Southern Mountain, Mt. Laixin; Qiaoying Village, Yilong Wharf etc.). No Archon Quest. New characters: Xianyun, Gaming.

items.name: Version 4.5: Blades Weaving Betwixt Brocade
items.notes: Released 2024-03-13. No new region. No Archon Quest. New character: Chiori.

items.name: Version 4.6: Two Worlds Aflame, the Crimson Night Fades
items.notes: Released 2024-04-24. New areas: Sea of Bygone Eras (Remuria's remains), Nostoi Region (Petrichor, Faded Castle). No Archon Quest. New character: Arlecchino.

items.name: Version 4.7: An Everlasting Dream Intertwined
items.notes: Released 2024-06-05. No new area listed. Archon Quest Chapter IV Act VI - Bedtime Story (Fontaine epilogue). New characters: Clorinde, Sigewinne, Sethos.

items.name: Version 4.8: Summertide Scales and Tales
items.notes: Released 2024-07-17. Limited-time area: Simulanka. No Archon Quest. New character: Emilie.

items.name: Version 5.0: Flowers Resplendent on the Sun-Scorched Sojourn
items.notes: Released 2024-08-28. New region: Natlan (Basin of Unnumbered Flames, Coatepec Mountain, Tequemecan Valley, Toyac Springs). Archon Quest Chapter V Acts I-II (Flowers Resplendent on the Sun-Scorched Sojourn; Black Stone Under a White Stone). New characters: Mualani, Kinich, Kachina.

items.name: Version 5.1: The Rainbow Destined to Burn
items.notes: Released 2024-10-09. No new region. Archon Quest Chapter V Acts III-IV (Beyond the Smoke and Mirrors; The Rainbow Destined to Burn). New character: Xilonen.

items.name: Version 5.2: Tapestry of Spirit and Flame
items.notes: Released 2024-11-20. New areas: Tezcatepetonco Range, Quahuacan Cliff, Ochkanatlan. Archon Quest Chapter V Interlude - All Fires Fuel the Flame. New characters: Chasca, Ororon.

items.name: Version 5.3: Incandescent Ode of Resurrection
items.notes: Released 2025-01-01. No new region. Archon Quest Chapter V Act V - Incandescent Ode of Resurrection. New characters: Mavuika, Citlali, Lan Yan.

items.name: Version 5.4: Moonlight Amidst Dreams
items.notes: Released 2025-02-12. New location: Aisa Bathhouse (instance, Inazuma). No Archon Quest. New character: Yumemizuki Mizuki.

items.name: Version 5.5: Day of the Flame's Return
items.notes: Released 2025-03-26. New areas: Atocpan, Ancient Sacred Mountain. No Archon Quest. New characters: Varesa, Iansan.

items.name: Version 5.6: Paralogism
items.notes: Released 2025-05-07. No new area. Archon Quest Interlude Chapter Act IV - Paralogism. New characters: Escoffier, Ifa.

items.name: Version 5.7: A Space and Time for You
items.notes: Released 2025-06-18. No new area. Archon Quest Chapter V Act VI - A Space and Time for You. New characters: Skirk, Dahlia.

items.name: Version 6.0: A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves
items.notes: Officially 'Version Luna I' (Song of the Welkin Moon: Segue); wiki number 6.0. Released 2025-09-10. New region: Nod-Krai (Lempo Isle, Hiisi Island, Paha Isle). Archon Quest Song of the Welkin Moon Acts I-II (A Dance of Snowy Tides and Hoarfrost Groves; Elegy of Dust and Lamplight). New characters: Lauma, Flins, Aino.

items.name: Version 6.1: An Elegy for Faded Moonlight
items.notes: Officially 'Version Luna II' (Song of the Welkin Moon: Reprise); wiki number 6.1. Released 2025-10-22. No new area listed. Archon Quest Song of the Welkin Moon Acts III-IV (A Nation That Doesn't Exist; An Elegy for Faded Moonlight). New character: Nefer (also Wonderland Manekin for Miliastra Wonderland).

items.name: Version 6.2: A Nocturne of the Far North
items.notes: Officially 'Version Luna III' (Song of the Welkin Moon: Interlude); wiki number 6.2. Released 2025-12-03. No new area listed. Archon Quest Song of the Welkin Moon Acts V-VI (A Nocturne of the Far North; Melting Moonlight in the Morning Mist). New characters: Durin, Jahoda.

items.name: Version 6.3: A Traveler on a Winter's Night
items.notes: Officially 'Version Luna IV' (Song of the Welkin Moon: Postlude); wiki number 6.3. Released 2026-01-14. New area: Nod-Krai - The Lament of the Cliff-Shadowed Hollow (Voidsea Outlook, Wavechaser Plain, Ashveil Peak). Archon Quest Song of the Welkin Moon Acts VII-VIII (A Traveler on a Winter's Night; True Moon). New characters: Columbina, Zibai, Illuga.

items.name: Version 6.4: Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind
items.notes: Officially 'Version Luna V' (Song of the Welkin Moon: Variation); wiki number 6.4. Released 2026-02-25. No new area listed. No Archon Quest (Varka Story Quest Lupus Majoris Chapter). New character: Varka.

items.name: Version 6.5: Augured Homecoming
items.notes: Officially 'Version Luna VI' (Song of the Welkin Moon: Rondo); wiki number 6.5. Released 2026-04-08. New areas: Windrest Peak (Mondstadt), Temple of Space. No Archon Quest listed. New character: Linnea.

items.name: Version 6.6: Truth Amongst the Pages of Purana
items.notes: Officially 'Version Luna VII' (Song of the Welkin Moon: Andante); wiki number 6.6. Released 2026-05-20. No new area listed. Archon Quest Song of the Welkin Moon Acts IX-X (As All Falls to Emptiness; Of Myriad Paths, Flux, and Dissolution). New characters: Nicole, Lohen, Prune.

items.name: Version 6.7: Sunny Summer Fontinalia
items.notes: Officially 'Version Luna VIII' (Song of the Welkin Moon: Scherzo); wiki number 6.7. Released 2026-07-01. New areas: Dunanna Pit, Frost Moon (Lunar Highlands, Moontide Sea, Dark Side of the Moon). No Archon Quest. New character: Sandrone.

items.name: Version 7.0: Everwinter Without Mercy
items.notes: Released 2026-08-12. New region: Snezhnaya (Volkodlak Tundra, Everfrozen Earth, Fellfrost Peak, Flamefeather Valley, White Birch Snowgrave). Archon Quest Chapter VII Acts I-II (Everwinter Without Mercy; Wraith's Nocturne). New characters: Odette, Alyosha.

items.name: Version 7.1: A Rekviem for the Underworld
items.notes: Released 2026-09-23. Canon cutoff. No new area listed (wiki page is a stub). Archon Quest Chapter VII Acts III-IV (White Night, Like a Dream Upon Waking; A Rekviem for the Underworld). New characters: Vesna, Vodyanitsa.

items.name: Matra and Mahamatra
items.notes: Akademiya enforcement; Mahamatra heads each Darshan's Matra; General Mahamatra is Cyno.

items.name: Nightsoul
items.notes: Natlan power derived from ancestral spirits/Night Kingdom; 'Nightsoul' redirects to Nightsoul's Blessing.

items.name: Starshyna
items.notes: Leader of the Lightkeepers; current Nikita, predecessor Sigurd, first Solovei. Introduced Luna I.

items.name: Guuji
items.notes: Chief priestess title of the Grand Narukami Shrine (Yae Miko); predecessor Kitsune Saiguu.

items.name: Moonchanter
items.notes: Title of the Frostmoon Scions' leader (Lauma) per faction infobox; no standalone page.

items.name: Oculus
items.notes: Element-crystallized collectibles; lore significance minor.

items.name: Oprichnik
items.notes: Fatui Oprichniki (elite enforcers?) introduced Luna I; enemy/faction overlap - verify role.
